# AI Agent Project - Copilot Instructions

This is a comprehensive AI project with the following components:
- Model training, testing, and evaluation pipeline
- AI Agent using Microsoft Agent Framework
- REST API for model inference and agent interaction
- React UI for agent prompting
- Azure Development Kit (ADK) evaluation
- Docker deployment for local system

## Project Structure Guidelines
- Use Python for backend, model training, and AI agent
- Use React for frontend UI
- Use FastAPI for REST API
- Use Microsoft Agent Framework for AI agent development
- Use GitHub models for cost-effective development
- Follow best practices for AI model development and deployment
